587-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
587-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sawtooth Loon by paying its mana cost.
When Sawtooth Loon enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand, draw four cards, and put four cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

1170-7444-8210.easyPrerequisites:
Advanced Reconstruction is level 3.
Konstrari Improviser is prepared.
1170-7444-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-4779-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-7729.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

457-1409-7154-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Condor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Condor leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Condor
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Condor when it left the battlefield.
When the Mutagens enter, Arcbound Condor triggers that many times, giving a creature an opponent controls -1/-1 until end of turn for each trigger.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Condor and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-7154-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-3644-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Young Wolf enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Young Wolf enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 7, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
413-3644-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 5 instead.

483-4681-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

862-2173-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1395-5051-5078-6006.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha and Traxos trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Traxos trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-3980.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Sisay's Ring and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2034-4702-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1786-3591-4444-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1786-3591-4444-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

813-2104-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Displace.
813-2104-3647.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2018-2981-5570.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

488-641-1482-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1482-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

643-997-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-997-1429-5402.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1987-2103-4423-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-4423-4477.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

1479-5361-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1651-4231-5469.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may produce Blood tokens using Transmutation Font instead.

152-2034-4094-5446.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
152-2034-4094-5446.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

57-232-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-2034-2178.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

1734-2034-3603-4605.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
The token dies, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1458-3459-5034.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1458-3459-5034.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Battered Golem.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Sol Ring enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2782-4499.notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
2034-2782-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nevinyrral.
Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that's died this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2278-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Bog Serpent.
A player controls no Swamps.
2278-4447.description:
If necessary, at the beginning of the upkeep of an opponent who controls no Swamps, Assault Suit triggers, causing that player to gain control of Bog Serpent and untap it.
Bog Serpent triggers, but cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit's ability.
Step 2 repeats forever, resulting in a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
